title: Mitigating Bias in Text Classification via Prompt-Based Text Transformation

bias_targets.methodology: Training text classifiers (XGBoost and BiLSTM) to predict the author's country of origin (nationality) based on review text, and measuring the reduction in classification accuracy after applying prompt-based text transformations to anonymize or neutralize the text.

Analyzing shifts in model feature importance (TF-IDF) and word frequencies for dialect-specific linguistic cues (e.g., British vs. American English terms like 'queue' vs 'employee') before and after text transformation.
